Chapter 1015: 24: Peeking From Outer Space (Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 1015: Chapter 24: Peeking from Outer Space (Please Subscribe)_2

“At least the new homeland for the clan is settled.”

Lin Yuan looked up and gazed at the Star Tear ‘Fragment World’, thinking to himself.

Originally, he thought he had to settle for one of the less satisfactory ‘Fragment Worlds’, but unexpectedly, the most desirable Star Tear ‘Fragment World’ fell into his hands, and almost in a ‘free’ manner.

…

Deepest part of the Chaos Continent.

The Ancient Ming Venerable and the black-cloaked youth were observing scenes unfolding within the palace.

“That [Galaxy] has accepted the Fragment World.” The Ancient Ming Venerable exhaled lightly and a smile appeared on his face.

Based on the black-cloaked youth’s ‘premonition’ talent, he inferred that Lin Yuan would most likely become a Chaos Great Saint in the future. Faced with an existence of such boundless potential, not offending him was the basic requirement—anything else would be seeking death.

The next step would be to determine how to form a good relationship.

Establishing goodwill required careful planning; one must avoid making the other party feel pressured or uncomfortable. For example, if the Ancient Ming Venerable were to personally appear and send various treasures, it might instead alert Lin Yuan.

That would be a case of loss outweighing gain.

In situations where the other party needed something, secretly facilitating it from behind the scenes was often the best approach.

“This [Galaxy] must know that it was you, Ancient Ming, who instructed Wanqu to do so behind the scenes.” Narrated the black-cloaked youth.

Anyone who could cultivate to the Twelfth Rank wasn’t foolish. For Wanqu Sovereign to give away such a gift for no apparent reason, how could there not be the Ancient Ming Venerable pulling strings behind the scenes?

“That is certain.” The Ancient Ming Venerable nodded.

“However, the fact that your ‘premonition’ has allowed you to sense a crisis of certain death is truly extraordinary.” The Ancient Ming Venerable still marveled.

The future was uncertain; even the smallest change could spawn countless timelines.

The black-cloaked youth wasn’t unfamiliar with prodigiously talented cultivators, such as heirs or descendants of the Great Saints.

Yet, when facing these types of prodigious talents, the black-cloaked youth would only sense faint traces of danger, suggesting that the probability of these prodigious talents developing into threats remained negligible.

Among a million future timelines, perhaps only a couple would see them enter the Great Saint level.

But Lin Yuan?

That intense sense of crisis was almost overflowing. If it weren’t for the fact that Lin Yuan was right in front of him, still at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, the black-cloaked youth would have truly believed that he would ascend to Chaos Great Saint at the very next moment.

“It is unbelievable.” The black-cloaked youth nodded. He was also shocked at the time and had even doubted whether his ‘premonition’ talent was malfunctioning.

“What a pity that your ‘premonition’ talent only allows you to perceive crises but cannot capture more specific details; otherwise, you could easily seize the opportunity to form bonds of goodwill with this [Galaxy].”

The Ancient Ming Venerable sighed faintly, expressing regret.

At present, all he could do was strive to form a good relationship with Lin Yuan without offending him. As for a true bond of goodwill? That was still far off.

Forming true goodwill wasn’t so simple. Without a deep understanding of Lin Yuan’s temperament, the Ancient Ming Venerable dared not overdo things, lest he upset Lin Yuan and let his efforts go to waste.

Sending forth that ‘Fragment World’ was only because he observed Lin Yuan’s genuine desire for it; otherwise, the Ancient Ming Venerable wouldn’t act so recklessly.

“If I could perceive scenes beyond crises, would I still be stuck at the peak of Sovereign Realm?” The black-cloaked youth rolled his eyes.

‘Premonition’ is a time-based ability; under normal circumstances, it falls within the domain of Thirteenth Rank Perfect Time Beings. That the youth could barely perceive crises was already thanks to his extraordinary bloodline.

“It’s said that those Thirteenth Rank Time Beings can observe one timeline after another. To them, planning the present to orchestrate their desired future is entirely feasible.”

The Ancient Ming Venerable gazed absently, filled with longing.

And that’s just Thirteenth Rank Time Beings. If one considers Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Beings, they could tailor-make their future entirely. If dissatisfied with the future, they could gather themselves and return to the past to alter events until the future would satisfy them.

“Thirteenth Rank Time Beings—they are far away, entities pursued by numerous Great Saints across successive Cosmic Eras, wandering through most of the Chaos Void without ever being found.” The black-cloaked youth remarked.

Many peerless Great Saints spent their entire lives chasing after traces of Thirteenth Rank Time Beings.

“Yes, too far away indeed.” The Ancient Ming Venerable nodded, “But this [Galaxy] lies near.”

Being able to so closely approach a future Chaos Great Saint meant that as long as he proceeded cautiously, offering timely assistance when needed, the benefits could be boundless.

…

Main Universe.

Lin Yuan sat quietly beneath the starry sky.

“Time and space…”

Lin Yuan focused deeply. At present, his comprehension of space-time had reached the peak of the Seventh Realm, and he was merely a step away from surpassing into the Eighth Realm—this could happen at any moment.

“It is said that after the cosmic cataclysm, the rebirth of existence begins anew, and then the scene of chaos birthing all things will appear, providing great insights for understanding the transformation of specific powers rooted in Chaos Rule.”

Lin Yuan silently pondered but knew such a spectacle could only be witnessed within the universe itself. Outside of the universe? It would merely appear as a nebulous gray haze.

“When the cosmic cataclysm arrives, I’ll leave behind an avatar in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to observe how the universe regenerates.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even if he didn’t focus on observing the universe’s rebirth, he would still leave behind an avatar within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm as one of his survival strategies.

After all, the safety of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was indisputable; coupled with its isolation from causal time and space, even if Lin Yuan were to encounter insurmountable dangers within the Chaos Void, he could rely on the survival measures tied to his Xuanhuang Secret Realm avatar.

“Galaxy.”

At this moment, nine Xuanyuan Supremes, including Xia Qin, appeared.

“The clan’s migration is nearly complete, but lately, those Alien Strong Ones have been clamoring to fully integrate into our human civilization, seeking only that we bring them along.”

Xia Qin Supreme gazed at Lin Yuan and asked, “What’s your take on this matter, Galaxy?”

“Bring them along.”

Lin Yuan replied casually.

No matter which universe undergoes a cataclysmic collapse, the vast majority of life forms will perish with it—even the survival rate of Twelve Rank beings will be slim.

That the human civilization could achieve a complete evacuation owed entirely to Lin Yuan.

Thus, for those abandoned Alien Strong Ones, opting to pledge themselves utterly to human civilization simply to survive was entirely reasonable.

Lin Yuan had no concerns regarding this. Total integration via pledging oneself was akin to enslavement, and they would certainly be subject to countless constraints, leaving no chance for rebellion.

“Understood.”

The nine Xuanyuan Supremes nodded in agreement before vanishing.

Moments later.

Two figures began to coalesce not far from where Lin Yuan was seated.

It was two Ultimate Beings of the Robber Clan.

“Galaxy Supreme.”

The two Robber Clan Ultimates slightly bowed toward Lin Yuan, speaking respectfully.

“Hmm.” Lin Yuan opened his eyes and gazed toward them.

The two Robber Clan Ultimate Beings felt their hearts tremble; as Lin Yuan’s gaze descended upon them, they experienced an inexplicable sensation of their souls incessantly plummeting.

“A single glance is enough to instill soul-level descent; were Galaxy Supreme intent on killing us, not even the protection of ancestral sanctuaries would save us.”

The two Robber Clan Ultimates swallowed nervously, speculating inwardly.

“It’s no wonder he’s the reincarnation of a Great Saint, remaining so formidable even under the suppression of the universe.”

The Robber Clan hailed from a Chaos Void Great Saint-level faction, leaving the two Ultimate Beings privy to numerous esoteric truths. They were acutely aware of the difficulty Lin Yuan’s achievements represented.

“Without the suppressive influence of the universe, Galaxy Supreme would likely ascend in one bound to rapidly reclaim his status as a Great Saint.”

The two Robber Clan Ultimate Beings marveled inwardly. “Is Galaxy Supreme aiming to break through to that ultimate step?”

“What reason brings you here?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze fell upon the two Ultimate Beings and he asked calmly.

Regarding the secrets of the Robber Clan, Lin Yuan already knew them thoroughly, including details about the wooden cabin—it was no longer much of a mystery.

“Galaxy Supreme, as the cosmic cataclysm draws near, while your strength may safeguard you against the obliteration calamity of the cataclysm, caution should still be exercised…”

The Ultimate Being on the left spoke with a tone of grave concern, his gaze fixed beyond the universe.

“Caution beyond the universe?”

Lin Yuan similarly gazed outward, his expression thoughtful.
